text_markup: To determine if the Runner's installed programs satisfy the restrictions on their [MU], create a mapping that assigns each 1[MU] in the memory cost of each installed program to a specific source (either the Runner's starting memory limit or an ability providing additional [MU]). The total [MU] assigned to each source must not exceed the amount of [MU] it provides, and all programs with [MU] assigned to a given source must meet all restrictions imposed on that [MU]. If it is not possible to create such a mapping, the Runner is considered to have exceeded their memory limit, and they must trash installed programs as described in {ref:rule_program_memory_cost}.
